title: A Heat Kernel Expectation Approach to Boundary-Corrected Li--Yau Estimates for the Dirichlet Heat Equation
summary: In this paper, we establish an explicit boundary-corrected Li--Yau type gradient estimate for positive solutions of the Dirichlet heat equation on the Euclidean half-space. The main idea is to exploit the reflection structure of the Dirichlet heat kernel and introduce a normalized kernel-induced probability measure. Under this representation, logarithmic derivatives of the heat kernel become expectations of explicit kernel quantities.
